capabilities: Upload pasted and drag-and-dropped images to a Roim PicX instance
Detect and upload external image URLs in notes, including Web Clipper output
Rewrite original image URLs with PicX URLs in the note
Decode camo.githubusercontent.com URLs and skip non-content images like badges
Configure API endpoint, token, image prefix, and post-upload behavior
extras: Manual installation from GitHub Releases is required; no community plugin store install is described.
problem: Obsidian keeps pasted images as local vault files and leaves external image URLs untouched, with no built-in way to host images on a self-hosted PicX service.

relations.evidence: Auto-upload images to your Roim PicX instance from Obsidian.
Automatically uploads external images when you clip articles using Obsidian Web Clipper

summary: Image uploader that sends pasted, dropped, or externally linked images to a Roim PicX instance and rewrites note URLs to the hosted copies.
